label: GPT-6 Astra
output:
Some good news: Priya Bhatia joins us on Monday 16 November, and I’m genuinely delighted to welcome her.

Priya is a chartered structural engineer (IStructE) with nine years at a consultancy in Coventry. Having her on board means we can share the workload properly and get things moving more quickly for those planning wall removals and loft conversions. If she comes out to your home, please say hello!

It’s also time for an honest word about the last two months. In September and October, our turnaround for beam calculations and drawings stretched to 5–6 weeks. That was too long. Several clients were understandably unhappy, and the criticism we received was deserved.

One couple in Harborne had their steel ordered and their builder waiting. We got their calculations to them in three days once we prioritised the job, but only after they’d chased twice. They shouldn’t have had to.

Those delays were my responsibility. I said yes to too much work on my own. Doing site visits during the day and calculations until midnight wasn’t a sensible way to run things, however many hours I put in. I’m sorry to everyone we kept waiting.

**With Priya joining, our new turnaround target for beam calculations and drawings is 10 working days.** That’s a target we need to earn your confidence in by meeting it, not just announcing it. If you’re waiting now, your job is moving forward, and you can message me directly for an update.

There’s one other change: **first site visits taking place from 1 January 2027 will cost £95**, deducted from our fee if you go ahead. Around a third of free visits haven’t led to a job, so we need to make that time sustainable.

**Any visit already booked when this post is published stays free, whatever its date.** Visits taking place before January remain free too.

Thank you for sticking with us. I’m looking forward to a better service for you—and to welcoming Priya on Monday.
